mons.title: ARMADIGO
mons.desc: Armadigos may use|their drills to dig into|Earth's boiling center.

mons.title: FALCANO
mons.desc: Flying near active|volcanos, Falcanos|enjoy diving in lava.

mons.title: FLARION
mons.desc: Rare to be seen,|Flarion's tail is|made of pure fire.

mons.title: HOPCHOP
mons.desc: Often seen as cute,|Hopchops may turn|quite dangerous.

mons.title: SPARKAT
mons.desc: It is said that looking|into a Sparkat's eyes|may bring bad luck.

mons.title: LAVAPEDE
mons.desc: Despite their small size,|Lavapedes are known|to start forest fires.

mons.title: MENZA
mons.desc: Lurking on trees,|Menzas are quick to|attack any threat.

mons.title: PYROPINE
mons.desc: The flames on the|Pyropine's back are|usually safe to touch.

mons.title: REXAROO
mons.desc: Rexaroos have a|pocket in their belly|used to hold babies.

mons.title: KRIMSON
mons.desc: Krimson, the Fire|Dragon. Some say his|breath can melt rocks.

mons.title: AVIATOS
mons.desc: Many songs were|written about Aviatos,|Guardian of Woods.

mons.title: GRUBBLE
mons.desc: Many people confuse|this bug Dynamon|with a plain stone.

mons.title: JEEMPY
mons.desc: Commonly found on|green hills, Jeempys|feed on grass.

mons.title: LEAFROG
mons.desc: Leafrogs like wet areas,|allowing their leaves|to grow healthy.

mons.title: NINTOISE
mons.desc: Nintoise shells are|known as one of the|hardest materials.

mons.title: PUMPKING
mons.desc: Pumpkings carry babies|on their head like a|royal crown.

mons.title: QUACKO
mons.desc: Quackos fly using|their big leaf to escape|cold season.

mons.title: FENECORN
mons.desc: Hiding in tall grass,|Fenecorns are very|quick and friendly.

mons.title: TUFFNUT
mons.desc: When fully grown,|the Tuffnut's cup can|be harder than a rock.

mons.title: DUXEDO
mons.desc: Duxedos quack at|each other to alert|of nearby enemies.

mons.title: MALAKITE
mons.desc: Malakite, the Earth|Dragon. Legends tell|of his mighty roar.

mons.title: HYDRON
mons.desc: Swimming underwater,|Hydrons hunt using|their toxic tentacles.

mons.title: LAMPION
mons.desc: Seeing a Lampion|is unusual, as it lives|deep underwater.

mons.title: PENGOO
mons.desc: Mostly found in cold|places, Pengoos like|to roll in snow.

mons.title: PODAPOD
mons.desc: Podapods can use the|water in their bodies|to heal their wounds.

mons.title: SHELLBY
mons.desc: Stroking the Shellby's|shell is believed to|bring good fortune.

mons.title: TAILTON
mons.desc: Tailtons spend most|days by soaking their|tails in cold waters.

mons.title: VULFROST
mons.desc: Vulfrosts hide in|forests and signal|the start of winter.

mons.title: WINGER
mons.desc: Flying between trees,|Wingers are active|mostly at night.

mons.title: KOBALT
mons.desc: Kobalt, the Water|Dragon. Some believe|he can create oceans.

mons.title: ENZATION
mons.desc: Born inside thunderclouds,|Enzation discharges fierce|lightning across the field.

mons.title: PIKACHU
mons.desc: Stores electric power in|its cheeks and unleashes|lightning bolts in battle.

mons.title: BULBASAUR
mons.desc: Carries a mysterious seed|bulb on its back that|blooms with vine power.

mons.title: CHARMANDER
mons.desc: The flame burning on|the tip of its tail|shows its fiery spirit.

mons.title: SQUIRTLE
mons.desc: Shelters behind a sturdy|shell and blasts foes|with pressurized water.

mons.title: HYPERBUG
mons.desc: Phasing out of shadow,|Hyperbug evades incoming|blows and feeds on the void.

mons.title: NYXALON
mons.desc: An enigmatic astral dark|entity that commands the|eclipse from beyond.

bossBattle.taunt: I'll give you coins if you win!
Going to the ARENA? Beat me first!
It all boils down to this.

captainTaunts.name: kolin
pool: I hope to become a great Captain!

captainTaunts.name: remi
pool: I've been looking for some competition!

captainTaunts.name: sofia
pool: Are you just going to stand there?
Looking for a battle? I'm in!

captainTaunts.name: nora
pool: Get ready for some REAL challenge!

taunts: This is the Arena, prepare yourself!
Arena battles are tough, but worth it!

content.text: Hello, will you become|a Dynamon Captain?
NICE! You've got some skills.|Now choose your own Dynamon!
Splendid choice.|Your Dynamon adventure begins!
Let's find some wild|Dynamons to BATTLE!
WAIT! Now that it's weak|let's try to CATCH it!
WOW! Your Dynamon can LEVEL UP!
We use DYNASTONES to do that.|Use one now!
You can SWITCH Dynamons during battle.
Let's use the Vulfrost you just caught!
Looks like another Captain|is blocking the road...
Go and BATTLE him!
Kolin gave you some COINS.|You can spend them at the SHOP!
You can use ITEMS during battle.
Use the Canned Attack you just got!
Greetings, rival Captain!
I'm going to battle in the ARENA|and become the strongest Champion.
Come fight me, if you like.|Maybe you could learn a thing or two.
Dynamons can take time to heal...
Use Healing Kits to heal them NOW!
Good, you finally came here.
My Dynamons could use the practice|before I go to the ARENA battle.
ARGH! You got lucky.|Next time it won't be that easy!
I see YOU, young Captain.
I hope to meet you after you|win the ARENA battle...
... IF you win the ARENA battle.
Train harder if you want to be|able to win ARENA battles.
I'll be waiting for you here.
Great, you made it to the ARENA!|Go ahead and challenge the Champion.
I'm waiting for you.|Come meet me after the bridge.
I give up... You are stronger.
Be careful of SUMSUM.|His powers are... DARK!
You don't stand a CHANCE.
This is your END.
I teach my Dynamons to HATE.|They FEAR me!
Your love for Dynamons weakens you.|It's PATHETIC.
What?! IMPOSSIBLE!|You have not seen the last of me!
THAT WAS INCREDIBLE!|Now try to CATCH all Dynamons!
WOW! That was AMAZING!|Return daily for new ARENA battles!
Impressive. You've won.
You treat Dynamons with respect.|You care for them.
You are WEAK.
Fighting against me will prove much|more difficult. Come see me...
... If you DARE.
